(196256) 2003 EH
1
is an
asteroid
, classified as a
near-Earth object
of the
Amor group
. It was discovered on 6 March 2003, by astronomers of the
LONEOS
program at
Anderson Mesa Station
near Flagstaff, Arizona, in the United States.
[
2
]
[
4
]
Peter Jenniskens
(2003–2004) proposed that it is the parent body of the
Quadrantid
meteor shower
.
[
5
]
[
6
]
2003 EH
1
is likely an
extinct comet
and may even be related to the comet
C/1490 Y1
.
2003 EH
1
came to
perihelion
on 12 March 2014.
